newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Orient B shares open at HK$4.88.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient B shares open at HK$4.88.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics B shares opened at HK$4.88 on their first day of trading on the Shenzhen stock exchange on Tuesday, up from an offer price of HK$3.08.
Beijing last week ordered all state banks to unwind their stock market positions within 10 sessions to reduce the flow of "hot money", or speculative funds, into China's heated markets.
Banks were also ordered to stop trading on the treasury debt repurchase market, through which large amounts of bank funds were channelled into the equity markets.
The ban followed recent moves to stop state and listed firms from speculative stock trading.
"I expect the stock to hover below its opening level because the new policies have dampened the overall market mood," the Guotai analyst said.
Beijing Orient reaped a net profit of 111.4 million yuan in 1996 compared with 102.1 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
China Southern Securities is the listing sponsor and chief domestic underwriter.
